title: hide_sprite probe (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only overlay for the 3D phase M3 `hide_sprite`: the vanilla Rat wears a magenta box (models/unit-box.gltf, a copy of _unitmodel's) at scale 0.4, and `hide_sprite true` leaves the Rat's 2D sprite undrawn while the box draws. Load with fw-3d: `mods: dev-sandbox, fw-3d, _unithide`. The control is _unithideoff (hide_sprite false). Never for play.
